notes: No misreadings found. Two borderline points for a human reviewer. (1) /configuration/1 turns an evidence observation into advice: the evidence says a wrapper component around an IconButton 'would stretch', but it never says to avoid wrappers. The recommendation is a reasonable inference and fits the anatomy text ('A direct IconButton child keeps its own circular size'), but it is the extractor's inference, not stated guidance. (2) /anatomy/2 marks Gap as alwaysPresent=true, but a gap only exists between two or more children. This is harmless for the multi-child groups the guide describes.
